segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're going outside for our lesson.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们要出去上课。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are gardening.
segments.zh: 今天我们正在园艺。

segments.en: We are going to set up our own garden.
segments.zh: 我们要建立自己的花园。

segments.en: Okay, that means growing plants and maybe even food.
segments.zh: 好吧，这意味着种植植物甚至食物。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to this dialogue and we'll be back in a moment to talk more about it.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听这个对话，我们稍后会回来讨论更多。

segments.en: I've decided to grow my own garden.
segments.zh: 我决定种植自己的花园。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You don't know the first thing about gardening.
segments.zh: 你对园艺一窍不通。

segments.en: On the contrary, I've been reading a lot of books about the subject.
segments.zh: 相反，我读了很多关于这个主题的书。

segments.en: Oh yeah?
segments.zh: 哦，是吗？

segments.en: Tell me then, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 那你说说看啊，自作聪明的家伙。

segments.en: How will you go about setting up your garden?
segments.zh: 你将如何设置你的花园？

segments.en: Well, first I need to buy some things such as fertilizer, seeds and tools.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先我需要买一些东西，比如化肥、种子和工具。

segments.en: What type of tools?
segments.zh: 什么样的工具？

segments.en: You know, the basics.
segments.zh: 就是那些基本工具。

segments.en: A rake, shovel, spade and a hoe.
segments.zh: 耙子、铲子、铁锹和锄头。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well it seems like you have all your bases covered.
segments.zh: 嗯，看来你准备得挺周全。

segments.en: What's next?
segments.zh: 接下来呢？

segments.en: I'll till the soil and then sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 我会耕种土壤，然后播种。

segments.en: I'll then add some fertilizer and voila, gardening all done.
segments.zh: 然后我会添加一些肥料，瞧，园艺都完成了。

segments.en: Well, good luck with your garden, especially considering we're in the dry season and it won't rain for the next three months.
segments.zh: 好吧，祝你花园好运，特别是考虑到我们处于旱季，未来三个月不会下雨。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So a lot of vocab related to gardening.
segments.zh: 所以很多与园艺有关的词汇。

segments.en: We mentioned a lot of tools and we're going to explain a lot of those now on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 我们提到了很多工具，我们将在语言外卖方面解释很多现在的工具。

segments.en: Okay, so gardening has some very special tools, like you said, Marco.
segments.zh: 好的，所以园艺有一些非常特殊的工具，就像你说的，马可。

segments.en: The first one is one that I am not, well, it's actually not a tool, it's a part of gardening, something that we use to help the plants grow and I really don't like it because it smells bad.
segments.zh: 第一个是我不是，嗯，它实际上不是一个工具，它是园艺的一部分，我们用来帮助植物生长的东西，我真的不喜欢它，因为它闻起来很臭。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: It smells kind of bad and it has a very strong smell and that is called fertilizer.
segments.zh: 它闻起来有点难闻，它有一种非常强烈的气味，这被称为肥料。

segments.en: Fertilizer.
segments.zh: 肥料。

segments.en: So basically, fertilizer is something that you use in your garden to help the plants grow better.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，肥料是你在花园里用来帮助植物更好地生长的东西。

segments.en: Right, I think it has a lot of vitamins and minerals that the plant needs to grow better, faster, stronger.
segments.zh: 对，我认为它含有大量的维生素和矿物质，植物需要更好、更快、更强壮地生长。

segments.en: Exactly, fertilizer.
segments.zh: 没错，肥料。

segments.en: Okay, good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: Well, now we're going to mention four tools that we use in gardening, basic tools.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我们将提到我们在园艺、基本工具中使用的四种工具。

segments.en: The first one being a rake.
segments.zh: 第一个是耙子。

segments.en: A rake.
segments.zh: 一个耙子。

segments.en: Rake.
segments.zh: 耙。

segments.en: Rake.
segments.zh: 耙。

segments.en: So a rake is actually something that's very common in most houses, especially houses with a yard or a garden.
segments.zh: 所以耙实际上在大多数房屋中很常见，尤其是有院子或花园的房屋。

segments.en: It's not just a gardening tool, but it is something that has a long handle and we use it to clear the ground of rocks or leaves.
segments.zh: 它不仅仅是一个园艺工具，它是一个长柄的东西，我们用它来清理岩石或树叶的地面。

segments.en: Right, so just imagine it's kind of like a big brush for your garden.
segments.zh: 对，所以想象一下它有点像你花园的大刷子。

segments.en: It is.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: It collects things, right?
segments.zh: 它收集东西，对吧？

segments.en: Right, it's like a big brush that's pulling things out of the ground or away from the ground, especially in the fall, like October or November when all the leaves fall off.
segments.zh: 是的，它就像一把大刷子，把东西从地上或远离地面拉出来，尤其是在秋天，比如十月或十一月，所有的叶子都掉下来了。

segments.en: Like October or November when all the leaves fall off the trees and you have to take them off the grass, you use a rake to pull them.
segments.zh: 就像 10 月或 11 月，当所有的叶子从树上掉下来，你必须把它们从草地上取下来时，你用耙子把它们拉下来。

segments.en: So you use a rake to pull them and you also call the action of using a rake, you say, you rake the garden.
segments.zh: 所以你用耙子拉它们，你也叫用耙子的动作，你说，你耙花园。

segments.en: To rake, that's right.
segments.zh: 拉克，是对的。

segments.en: To rake the leaves.
segments.zh: 耙叶子。

segments.en: I hate raking the leaves.
segments.zh: 我讨厌耙树叶。

segments.en: Alright, and now the other tool that we have is very common, not only in gardening, but for construction work, for many things.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我们拥有的另一个工具很常见，不仅在园艺方面，而且在建筑工作中，对于许多事情。

segments.en: You have a shovel.
segments.zh: 你有一把铲子。

segments.en: Shovel.
segments.zh: 铲。

segments.en: So a shovel is basically a big metal spoon.
segments.zh: 所以铲子基本上是一个大金属勺子。

segments.en: And you use it to make a hole in the ground.
segments.zh: 你用它在地上打一个洞。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, as we say, we use it a lot in gardening to make holes for maybe the plants, but also in construction, if you want to make a hole in the ground, things like this, you use a shovel.
segments.zh: 所以，正如我们所说，我们在园艺中经常使用它来为植物打洞，但在建筑中，如果你想在地面上打个洞，像这样的东西，你用铲子。

segments.en: And now a smaller version of the shovel that you use only with your hand, this is called a spade.
segments.zh: 现在是你只用手使用的小铲子版本，这称为铁锹。

segments.en: A spade.
segments.zh: 一把铁锹。

segments.en: Now this is very small, like you said, and it's actually special because of its shape.
segments.zh: 现在这很小，就像你说的，它实际上是因为它的形状而特别。

segments.en: A spade has a point.
segments.zh: 黑桃有一点。

segments.en: A shovel is round and a spade has a point.
segments.zh: 铲子是圆的，铁锹有点。

segments.en: And what's interesting, Marco, is it's actually very common somewhere else.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，马可，它实际上在其他地方很常见。

segments.en: In cards.
segments.zh: 在卡片中。

segments.en: That's right, in cards.
segments.zh: 没错，在卡片中。

segments.en: So cards have different shapes.
segments.zh: 所以卡片有不同的形状。

segments.en: One is a heart, one is a diamond.
segments.zh: 一种是心，一种是钻石。

segments.en: One of them is a spade.
segments.zh: 其中之一是铁锹。

segments.en: So the one that's pointy, that's called a spade, and it's used for digging kind of precision holes.
segments.zh: 所以那个尖尖的，被称为铲子，它用于挖掘一种精确的孔。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So you don't want to use a big shovel if you want to make maybe a small hole in the ground, you would use a spade.
segments.zh: 所以你不想用大铲子如果你想在地上打一个小洞，你会用铁锹。

segments.en: And now our last tool has kind of a funny spelling.
segments.zh: 现在我们的最后一个工具有一种有趣的拼写。

segments.en: It's H-O-E, and it's pronounced hoe.
segments.zh: 它是 H-O-E，它的发音是锄头。

segments.en: Hoe.
segments.zh: 锄头。

segments.en: So again, this is a tool with a very long handle, and you use it to maybe make the ground softer or to turn up the ground.
segments.zh: 再说一次，这是一个带有很长手柄的工具，你可以用它来使地面更柔软或翻开地面。

segments.en: So when you're first starting to plant a garden, the ground is very hard, very tough, right?
segments.zh: 所以当你第一次开始种植花园时，地面非常坚硬，非常艰难，对吧？

segments.en: And this is a really important tool for that period because you can basically turn up the ground.
segments.zh: 这在那个时期是一个非常重要的工具，因为你基本上可以把地面翻起来。

segments.en: You're not digging anything, but you're mixing up the dirt a little bit to make it softer.
segments.zh: 你没有挖掘任何东西，但你会稍微混合一些污垢以使其更柔软。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So that's when you use this tool.
segments.zh: 这就是你使用这个工具的时候。

segments.en: It's kind of a dirt or a soil mixer.
segments.zh: 它是一种泥土或土壤混合器。

segments.en: You can also pull out those nasty weeds with a hoe.
segments.zh: 你也可以用锄头拔掉那些讨厌的杂草。

segments.en: Okay, good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So four key tools that we've just taken a look at now.
segments.zh: 所以我们现在刚刚看过的四个关键工具。

segments.en: But now let's move on to two verbs that are basically very important when you're talking about gardening and all this.
segments.zh: 但是现在让我们继续讨论两个在你谈论园艺和所有这一切时非常重要的动词。

segments.en: As you mentioned, you talked about mixing the soil.
segments.zh: 正如你所提到的，你谈到了混合土壤。

segments.en: And in the next line, we see that it says, I'll till the soil.
segments.zh: 在下一行，我们看到它说，我会耕种土壤。

segments.en: To till.
segments.zh: 直到。

segments.en: Okay, so basically this is a way of turning up that soil, but you're doing it kind of in lines, right?
segments.zh: 好的，所以基本上这是一种翻新土壤的方式，但你是在排队，对吧？

segments.en: So you're mixing up the soil and making it soft.
segments.zh: 所以你正在混合土壤并使其柔软。

segments.en: You're preparing the soil for planting.
segments.zh: 你正在准备种植土壤。

segments.en: And so you till the soil.
segments.zh: 所以你直到土壤。

segments.en: Soil of course, in this case, is that dirt.
segments.zh: 当然，在这种情况下，土壤是污垢。

segments.en: It's earth.
segments.zh: 这是地球。

segments.en: Right, it's earth.
segments.zh: 没错，是地球。

segments.en: So to till is to prepare it for planting.
segments.zh: 所以要耕种是为种植做好准备。

segments.en: Till the soil, that's right.
segments.zh: 到土壤，就对了。

segments.en: To till the soil, okay.
segments.zh: 耕地，好吧。

segments.en: And what do we do after the soil has been tilled?
segments.zh: 土壤耕种后我们该怎么办？

segments.en: Well then we sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 那么我们播种。

segments.en: Okay, so seeds are baby plants basically.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以种子基本上是婴儿植物。

segments.en: And we sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 我们播种。

segments.en: When we sow the seeds, we're putting the seeds into the ground.
segments.zh: 当我们播种时，我们将种子放入地下。

segments.en: So that's basically planting the seeds.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上就是种子。

segments.en: You can say we plant the seeds or we sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 你可以说我们播种或播种。

segments.en: And the opposite of sowing?
segments.zh: 与播种相反？

segments.en: The opposite of sowing is reaping.
segments.zh: 播种的反面是收获。

segments.en: R-E-A-P, to reap.
segments.zh: R-E-A-P，收获。

segments.en: So we actually have a phrase in English.
segments.zh: 所以我们实际上有一个英语短语。

segments.en: This is very, very famous, very common.
segments.zh: 这是非常非常有名的，非常常见的。

segments.en: We say, you reap what you sow.
segments.zh: 我们说，你收获你播种的东西。

segments.en: You reap what you sow, that's right.
segments.zh: 你收获你种下的东西，这是对的。

segments.en: So you basically collect what you planted and that's kind of what you do in life.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上收集了你种植的东西，这就是你在生活中所做的事情。

segments.en: So we say if you haven't planted anything good, you're not going to reap anything good.
segments.zh: 所以我们说，如果你没有种植任何好东西，你就不会收获任何好东西。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: It's a very popular phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常流行的短语。

segments.en: All right, so we've covered a lot of vocab here.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们在这里介绍了很多词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we go back, listen to the dialogue again, and we'll be back with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去，再听一次对话，我们会带着 Flueny Builder 回来。

segments.en: I've decided to grow my own garden.
segments.zh: 我决定种植自己的花园。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You don't know the first thing about gardening.
segments.zh: 你对园艺一窍不通。

segments.en: On the contrary, I've been reading a lot of books about the subject.
segments.zh: 相反，我读了很多关于这个主题的书。

segments.en: Oh yeah?
segments.zh: 哦，是吗？

segments.en: Tell me then, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 那么告诉我，聪明的裤子。

segments.en: How will you go about setting up your garden?
segments.zh: 你将如何设置你的花园？

segments.en: Well, first I need to buy some things such as fertilizer, seeds, and tools.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先我需要买一些东西，比如化肥、种子和工具。

segments.en: What type of tools?
segments.zh: 什么样的工具？

segments.en: You know, the basics.
segments.zh: 就是那些基本工具。

segments.en: A rake, shovel, spade, and a hoe.
segments.zh: 耙子、铲子、铁锹和锄头。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, it seems like you have all your bases covered.
segments.zh: 好吧，似乎你已经涵盖了所有的基地。

segments.en: What's next?
segments.zh: 接下来呢？

segments.en: I'll till the soil and then sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 我会耕种土壤，然后播种。

segments.en: I'll then add some fertilizer and voila, gardening all done.
segments.zh: 然后我会添加一些肥料，瞧，园艺都完成了。

segments.en: Well, good luck with your garden, especially considering we're in the dry season and it won't rain for the next three months.
segments.zh: 好吧，祝你花园好运，特别是考虑到我们处于旱季，未来三个月不会下雨。

segments.en: All right, we're back and we have four phrases for you on Fluency Builder and we're going to take a look at those now.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，我们在 Fluency Builder 上有四个短语给你，我们现在要看看这些。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: This first phrase is useful in any conversation, I think, especially if you're trying to impress somebody.
segments.zh: 我认为，第一个短语在任何对话中都很有用，特别是如果你想给某人留下深刻印象。

segments.en: So basically, one person in this dialogue says, you know what, you don't know the first thing about gardening.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，这个对话中的一个人说，你知道什么，你不知道关于园艺的第一件事。

segments.en: That means you don't know anything about gardening.
segments.zh: 这意味着你对园艺一无所知。

segments.en: And what does he say in response?
segments.zh: 他在回应中说了什么？

segments.en: On the contrary.
segments.zh: 相反。

segments.en: On the contrary.
segments.zh: 相反。

segments.en: So the contrary means the opposite.
segments.zh: 所以相反的意思是相反的。

segments.en: So basically this means the opposite is true.
segments.zh: 所以基本上这意味着相反是正确的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You're basically saying, I disagree.
segments.zh: 你基本上是说，我不同意。

segments.en: What you are saying is false.
segments.zh: 你说的是假的。

segments.en: It's actually the opposite.
segments.zh: 其实是相反的。

segments.en: So maybe I have a feeling, Marco, that it's going to rain tomorrow.
segments.zh: 所以也许我有一种感觉，马可，明天会下雨。

segments.en: Actually, on the contrary, I saw in the news that it's going to be very sunny tomorrow.
segments.zh: 实际上，相反，我在新闻中看到明天将非常晴朗。

segments.en: Oh, well, that's good news.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧，这是个好消息。

segments.en: So that's a way of maybe politely disagreeing with someone or saying to someone that, well, you're wrong.
segments.zh: 所以这可能是一种礼貌地不同意某人或对某人说的方式，好吧，你错了。

segments.en: It's actually the opposite of what you're saying.
segments.zh: 这实际上与你所说的相反。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Moving on to our second phrase, it's actually a colloquial way of kind of making fun of someone when you say, all right, then, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 继续我们的第二个短语，当你说好吧，Smarty Pants 时，这实际上是一种取笑某人的口语方式。

segments.en: Okay, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 好啊，机灵鬼。

segments.en: Don't think about this too much.
segments.zh: 不要想太多。

segments.en: We're not talking about pants, actually.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们不是在谈论裤子。

segments.en: But this is a way of saying, okay, if you're so smart, then tell me that.
segments.zh: 但这是一种说法，好吧，如果你这么聪明，那就告诉我吧。

segments.en: It's sarcasm.
segments.zh: 这是讽刺。

segments.en: It's sarcasm.
segments.zh: 这是讽刺。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So this person says, oh, actually, I know a lot about gardening.
segments.zh: 所以这个人说，哦，实际上，我对园艺了解很多。

segments.en: And the other person says, oh, really, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 另一个人说，哦，真的，聪明的裤子。

segments.en: So you can actually describe a person in this way.
segments.zh: 所以你实际上可以用这种方式描述一个人。

segments.en: Maybe a person that thinks they know a lot or sometimes what you say, a Mr. Know-it-all.
segments.zh: 也许一个认为他们知道很多的人，或者有时你说什么，一个无所不知的先生。

segments.en: You also say, it's a smarty pants.
segments.zh: 你还说，这是一条聪明的裤子。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: A person that thinks they know a lot or everything even.
segments.zh: 一个认为他们知道很多甚至一切的人。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Mr. Know-it-all or a smarty pants.
segments.zh: Mr. Know-It-All 或 Smarty 裤子。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And our third phrase is interesting because we have a setup here.
segments.zh: 我们的第三个短语很有趣，因为我们在这里有一个设置。

segments.en: When the person says, how will you go about setting up your garden?
segments.zh: 当这个人说，你将如何设置你的花园？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So to go about doing something.
segments.zh: 所以去做某事。

segments.en: There's two important parts of this.
segments.zh: 这有两个重要的部分。

segments.en: So Marco, the first part is how you go about.
segments.zh: 所以马可，第一部分是你的方式。

segments.en: This means how you do.
segments.zh: 这意味着你是怎么做的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can say, how will you do this?
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，你将如何做到这一点？

segments.en: What's your approach?
segments.zh: 你的方法是什么？

segments.en: What's your approach?
segments.zh: 你的方法是什么？

segments.en: So how will you go about plus and then the verb in ing.
segments.zh: 那么你将如何去加上再加上动词。

segments.en: So how will you go about setting up your garden?
segments.zh: 那么你将如何设置你的花园呢？

segments.en: How will you start or what is your approach to creating your garden?
segments.zh: 您将如何开始或您创建花园的方法是什么？

segments.en: So maybe Marco, you want to write a book and I can ask you, well, how will you go about starting your book?
segments.zh: 所以也许马可，你想写一本书，我可以问你，嗯，你将如何开始你的书？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or if I'm writing a book, you can say, how will you go about investigating for your book?
segments.zh: 或者，如果我在写一本书，你可以说，你将如何为你的书调查？

segments.en: So what is the approach you're going to take?
segments.zh: 那么你将采取的方法是什么？

segments.en: How will you do it?
segments.zh: 你会怎么做？

segments.en: How do you plan on, how do you plan on doing something?
segments.zh: 你是如何计划的，你打算如何做某事？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And our final phrase here is a very commonly used for all sorts of situations.
segments.zh: 我们这里的最后一个短语是非常常用于各种情况的。

segments.en: Basically if a person is prepared, you say, well, you have all your bases covered.
segments.zh: 基本上，如果一个人做好了准备，你说，好吧，你的所有基础都被覆盖了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This is a great phrase.
segments.zh: 这个短语很实用。

segments.en: It comes right from sports.
segments.zh: 它来自体育。

segments.en: Very common in English to have sports phrases.
segments.zh: 在英语中很常见的有运动短语。

segments.en: This comes from the sport baseball.
segments.zh: 这来自体育棒球。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So in baseball, the field is a diamond.
segments.zh: 所以在棒球界，球场是钻石。

segments.en: There are four corners or four bases and the runners have to go from one base to the other one, two, three, four, and then they get a point.
segments.zh: 有四个角或四个基地，跑步者必须从一个基地到另一个基地到另一个基地，两个，三个，四个，然后他们得分。

segments.en: But in this case we're saying the other team, they have their bases covered.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，我们说的是另一支球队，他们的基地覆盖了。

segments.en: That means they're protecting their bases.
segments.zh: 这意味着他们正在保护他们的基地。

segments.en: And in speech we say, if you have your bases covered, like you said, Marco, you're very well prepared.
segments.zh: 在演讲中，我们说，如果你有你的基地，就像你说的，马可，你已经做好了充分的准备。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you're, you're ready, you're prepared.
segments.zh: 所以你准备好了，你准备好了。

segments.en: You have really planned out and thought of what you're going to do.
segments.zh: 你真的计划好了，想了想你要做什么。

segments.en: So you have all your bases covered.
segments.zh: 所以你的所有基地都得到了覆盖。

segments.en: So Marco, for example, you just told me that it's going to be sunny tomorrow, but I think it still might rain.
segments.zh: 所以马可，例如，你只是告诉我明天会是晴天，但我认为仍然可能会下雨。

segments.en: So to have all my bases covered, I'm going to bring an umbrella anyway.
segments.zh: 所以为了覆盖我所有的基地，无论如何我都会带一把雨伞。

segments.en: Just in case.
segments.zh: 以防万一。

segments.en: Just in case.
segments.zh: 以防万一。

segments.en: Or maybe you have a presentation at work and you've prepared your PowerPoint presentation.
segments.zh: 或者，也许您在工作中进行了演示，并且您已经准备了您的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

segments.en: You have your, your drawings, your copies, you have everything ready.
segments.zh: 你有你的，你的画，你的副本，你准备好了一切。

segments.en: You have all your bases covered for that meeting.
segments.zh: 您为那次会议涵盖了所有基地。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So why don't we go back and listen to our dialogue for the last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不回去听我们最后一次的对话，我们会回来多谈谈。

segments.en: I've decided to grow my own garden.
segments.zh: 我决定种植自己的花园。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: You don't know the first thing about gardening.
segments.zh: 你对园艺一窍不通。

segments.en: On the contrary, I've been reading a lot of books about the subject.
segments.zh: 相反，我读了很多关于这个主题的书。

segments.en: Oh yeah?
segments.zh: 哦，是吗？

segments.en: Tell me then, smarty pants.
segments.zh: 那么告诉我，聪明的裤子。

segments.en: How will you go about setting up your garden?
segments.zh: 你将如何设置你的花园？

segments.en: Well, first I need to buy some things such as fertilizer, seeds and tools.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先我需要买一些东西，比如化肥、种子和工具。

segments.en: What type of tools?
segments.zh: 什么样的工具？

segments.en: You know, the basics.
segments.zh: 就是那些基本工具。

segments.en: A rake, shovel, spade and a hoe.
segments.zh: 耙子、铲子、铁锹和锄头。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well it seems like you have all your bases covered.
segments.zh: 嗯，看来你准备得挺周全。

segments.en: What's next?
segments.zh: 接下来呢？

segments.en: I'll till the soil and then sow the seeds.
segments.zh: 我会耕种土壤，然后播种。

segments.en: I'll then add some fertilizer and voila, gardening all done.
segments.zh: 然后我会添加一些肥料，瞧，园艺都完成了。

segments.en: Well good luck with your garden, especially considering we're in the dry season and it won't rain for the next three months.
segments.zh: 祝你花园好运，特别是考虑到我们处于旱季，未来三个月不会下雨。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So gardening is actually a very popular thing in many countries.
segments.zh: 所以园艺在许多国家实际上是一个非常流行的事情。

segments.en: I know many people as well who prefer to have their own personal garden to grow their own vegetables which they say taste a lot different from the ones you buy at the supermarket.
segments.zh: 我也知道很多人喜欢拥有自己的私人花园来种植自己的蔬菜，他们说这些蔬菜的味道与您在超市购买的蔬菜有很大不同。

segments.en: They do.
segments.zh: 他们会。

segments.en: I think personally that home grown vegetables, so vegetables that you grow yourself, tend to taste a lot better than the ones you get in the grocery store.
segments.zh: 我个人认为，自制蔬菜，你自己种植的蔬菜，往往比你在杂货店买的蔬菜味道好很多。

segments.en: They also look different.
segments.zh: 它们看起来也不同。

segments.en: They're not as pretty, but that's because they have less chemicals.
segments.zh: 它们没有那么漂亮，但那是因为它们含有较少的化学物质。

segments.en: I think it's a very popular thing and well not only gardening your own vegetables but some people just enjoy it as a hobby to have some plants and different types of things in their backyard.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一件非常受欢迎的事情，不仅可以园艺自己的蔬菜，而且有些人只是将其作为一种爱好，在他们的后院有一些植物和不同类型的东西。

segments.en: Yeah, many people say it's very relaxing.
segments.zh: 是的，很多人说这很放松。

segments.en: You get to go outside, you're in the sunshine, it's a very calming activity.
segments.zh: 你可以出去，你在阳光下，这是一项非常平静的活动。

segments.en: It seems like it's very relaxing.
segments.zh: 看起来很放松。

segments.en: A little bit boring at times.
segments.zh: 有时有点无聊。

segments.en: Basically you're waiting for your plants to grow, but I imagine that once they do, you've accomplished it, it must be great to see that you've actually brought life.
segments.zh: 基本上你在等待你的植物生长，但我想一旦它们长大了，你就完成了它，很高兴看到你真的带来了生命。

segments.en: I'm sure.
segments.zh: 我确定。

segments.en: Like 20 minutes every day is not so bad.
segments.zh: 像每天20分钟也没有那么糟糕。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's actually a very interesting hobby and we want to know if in your country, in your town, do you have enough space for a garden?
segments.zh: 这实际上是一个非常有趣的爱好，我们想知道在您的国家，在您的城镇，您是否有足够的空间容纳花园？

segments.en: Do you like gardening or maybe growing your own food?
segments.zh: 你喜欢园艺还是自己种植食物？

segments.en: I think that's a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: Yeah, let us know what you think.
segments.zh: 是的，让我们知道你的想法。

segments.en: Do you do this?
segments.zh: 你这样做吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I do.
segments.zh: 是的，我愿意。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
